Ivy L.: Quick sync: BlueWave POC needs accelerated onboarding. Sales asks for 1-page runbook + minimal infra ticket template.
Marco G.: I'll copy the K/V pair for Hosted key creation. Zoe: can you confirm if they need Dedicated or Private?
Zoe H.: They asked for Dedicated with optional Private if SSO/SCIM required. For now plan Dedicated + KMS option.
Ivy L.: Dedicated ticket template (use fields exactly):
```
Title: Dedicated pool POC request - BlueWave
POC owner: <AE>
Requested capacity: 3 x a100-sXM
Target models: gpt-4o-mini, embed-lite
Start date: YYYY-MM-DD
Duration: 30 days
Egress: restricted to customer IP ranges, fallback to Hosted via api-key: poc-bluewave-hosted
Security contacts: zoe@redwood.com
Billing: POC2026 approved? yes/no
```
Marco G.: Also list an expected QA script: 1) generate embedding for sample doc, 2) run 100 concurrent requests to test batching, 3) measure p50/p95 latency.
EngOncall Bot: Reminder: allocate oncall window for the first 72 hours after provision.
Zoe H.: VPC/private run notes: get CIDR, request peering, confirm route propagation, apply SG rules for 443, provide DNS entry for the customer.
Legal Bot: If customer requests data processing addendum, route to legal @ legal-sig.
Ivy L.: Action items: Marco=hosted key steps, Zoe=KMS checklist and contact, I=assemble packet and upload to deal. ETA EOD today.
Zoe H.: Also confirm backup logging storage location for EU customers (S3 eu-west-1).
Ivy L.: Will do. Posting final packet here when available. :rocket:
